newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matif closed Nov 11, no GLOBEX trading session.
newsitem.headline: Matif closed Nov 11, no GLOBEX trading session.

text.p: French futures and options exchange Matif will be closed for a public holiday on November 11 and there will not be a session on the GLOBEX electronic trading system, a Matif spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"Matif will be closed. There will be no GLOBEX session on November 11," she told Reuters.
Matif held a GLOBEX trading session for the main French futures and options contracts from 0900 GMT to 1700 GMT on Friday, November 1, the most recent French public holiday.
